beats.text: Five things your future self will quietly thank you for.
One. Starting before you felt ready. The right time was always a myth.
Two. Saving a little, early. Small amounts and time do almost magical things together.
Three. Keeping the promises you made to yourself. That's where self-trust is built.
Four. Treating your body like it has to carry you for eighty more years. It does.
Five. Choosing boring consistency over exciting bursts. The tortoise really does win.
You can't go back and start sooner. But in a year, today is the 'sooner' you'll wish you'd used.
